property_summary: For every admissible input, initialize must set the public baseToken getter exactly to the _baseToken argument (the base token used for payments); the mutant sets baseToken to the _nft argument instead, so whenever _baseToken != _nft the invariant c.baseToken() == _baseToken is broken.
change_summary: Replace `baseToken = _baseToken;` with `baseToken = _nft;` so baseToken receives the NFT address argument instead.
